title: task.create — Response
description: 201 Created on first call. 200 OK on idempotent replay (same operation_id + same request_hash). 409 Conflict on operation_id reuse with different payload (response body in 409 case is the ORIGINAL cached response, not a fresh one). 410 Gone if operation_id has expired past retention.

event.description: The 'created' event written for this mutation.
